# useAnnouncer

> Polite or assertive screen-reader announcements through one shared, SSR-safe aria-live region.

🟡 intermediate · React 16.8+ · Custom Hooks › Accessibility & interaction · support: client-only

**Playground:** `npm run dev` → [`#/entry/use-announcer`](http://localhost:5173/#/entry/use-announcer)

## Concept

`announce(message, { politeness, clearAfterMs })` writes into one of two visually hidden regions (`role="status"` polite, `role="alert"` assertive) shared by every component. Regions are appended to `<body>` when the first announcer mounts and removed with the last.

## Problem

Live regions only work if they exist _before_ their content changes, repeated identical messages are not re-announced, regions mounted per component multiply, and stale text lingers for users who browse to it later.

## When to use

- Results of actions that do not move focus: "Added to cart", "3 results", "Saved", "Connection lost".
- Background events: uploads finished, new messages arrived.

## When not to use

- A message that has a natural place in the layout — render an inline `role="status"` element there instead (visible to everyone).
- Form errors on submit — move focus to the first invalid field (`useForm` does) rather than announcing.
- Anything that changes constantly (timers, progress every 100 ms) — users will hear nothing else.

## API

```ts
function useAnnouncer(): {
  announce: (
    message: string,
    options?: { politeness?: 'polite' | 'assertive'; clearAfterMs?: number },
  ) => void;
  clear: () => void;
};
```

| Parameter                           | Type                      | Description                                              |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options.politeness` _(optional)_   | `'polite' \| 'assertive'` | Default `polite`. Reserve `assertive` for urgent errors. |
| `options.clearAfterMs` _(optional)_ | `number`                  | Default `7000`.                                          |

**Returns:** Stable `announce` and `clear` functions.

## Execution flow

1. Mount effect: increment a module-level subscriber count and create the two regions if needed.
2. `announce`: empty the region, then set the text after `ANNOUNCE_DELAY_MS` (100 ms) so identical messages are re-announced; clear it after `clearAfterMs`.
3. Unmount: when the last subscriber leaves, timers are cleared and the regions removed. Calls after that are ignored.

## Common mistakes

### Rendering the live region together with its message

❌ Incorrect:

```tsx
{
  saved && <div aria-live="polite">Saved</div>;
}
```

Most screen readers ignore live regions that appear with content already in them. The region must exist first.

### Everything assertive

❌ Incorrect:

```tsx
announce('3 results', { politeness: 'assertive' });
```

Assertive messages interrupt whatever the user is listening to. Use polite for status updates.

## Edge cases

- Multiple announcements within 100 ms: the last one wins (the region is reset each time).
- Screen readers differ; test with at least one (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack).

## Browser support

Regions are created after mount; nothing is rendered on the server.

## Testing

Fake-timer tests verify one shared pair of regions with the right attributes, the delay-then-fill-then-clear cycle, re-announcing identical text, separate assertive routing, `clear()`, and that timers and regions are removed on the last unmount.
